fixed_feature_definitions.age_percentile: within active race average-rank percentile of entry-sheet age
fixed_feature_definitions.burden_percentile: within active race average-rank percentile of entry-sheet wgBudam
fixed_feature_definitions.burden_change: current entry-sheet wgBudam minus the horse's most recent prior wgBudam; train median for first observation
fixed_feature_definitions.sex_dummies: train categories, most prevalent train category dropped, unknown category all-zero

model: market-anchored conditional logit: softmax_r(log closing_q + X beta)
primary_uncertainty: race-day block bootstrap; a small number of fresh dates yields discrete, low-power uncertainty

relationship_to_frozen_models: separate minimal model, not a global29/partial30 replication
execution_status: retrospective probability benchmark only; closing odds are not executable snapshots
